stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Data often reflects who has access, confidence, and time to report.”?
options: Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.
In public planning, it is also a decision about the future city.
To understand a city, officials must listen beyond the easiest data points.
A person is more than data points.
